A must try in your in Vung Tau and love seafood! Great for large parties and a wide variety of food.
Sep 2024 • Family
Overall, the restaurant is primarily outdoors. It's quite spacious with a lot of seating, but I'd strongly recommend you call ahead to make a reservation. 

Ganh Hao was highly recommended by a few friends, but we couldn't secure a reservation, so went out to Ganh Hao 2 instead. The ambience was great as we were right on the water. It's quite loud but the service was solid. Our servers were constantly checking in on us, refilling our ice and drinks. The food is more on the pricier side, but if you're in Vung Tau, I'd strongly recommend going at least once and trying their oysters and seafood. 

Overall, definitely will be coming back next time to try more of their seafood! 

We ordered: 
- Aluminum Stir-Fied Tofu Combination - 5/5 best dish of the evening, so much flavor, the sauce went perfectly over rice and had a good spread of seafood and veggies 
- Vegetarian Egg Rolls - 3/5, it was your average vegetarian spring roll, crispy with the right amount of fillings
- Claypot Clams - 3/5, some clams were overcooked and this could have used a bit more flavor as it was slightly on the bland side, but great to try if you like clams, just make sure you dip in some fish sauce 
- Deep fried baby squid - 5/5, the squids were nice and crispy while tender given their size. perfect little bites that compliment rice really well 
- Fish Hot Pot - 3/5 your average hot pot, the soup was flavored and seasoned nicely and we had the right balance of veggies and vermicelli
- Shaking Beef with French Fries - 4/5 some of the pieces of beef were overcooked while others were perfectly tender, we ordered 2 plates, 1 was incredibly oily while the other was cooked nicely with hints of smokiness from the wok 
- Vietnamese Fish Papaya Salad - 3/5 there was a nice amount of saltiness and tang from the fish, but you really need to wrap this with the herbs and rice paper and dip in fish sauce to get the full depth of flavor 
- Stir-fried Water Spinach with Garlic - 4/5 cooked nicely with the right amount of garlic

How do they serve such ordinary food and yet get such a crowd?
Apr 2022
Various people recommended that I ate here, so I made a booking. It's a huge restaurant but was completely full on a Friday night.

Because this restaurant was literally being by the seaside, in a town known for its seafood, I had pretty high expectations for the food.

Completely disappointed. The seafood fried rice was so 'refined' that it lost its earthiness and tasted like something I'd get in an Australian suburban restaurant (not in a good way).

Worst dish was the fried baby oysters. When the dish arrived it looked like stodgy deep fried flour with little bits of darkness. It tasted even worse than it looked.

How can any restaurant serve something like this?

Never again

Good view and great food.
Aug 2020
I have eaten at this Gành Hào 2 restaurant every time I visited Vungtau, Vietnam. I like this restaurant better than the original Gành Hào at Mulberry beach which is so crowd, noisy and has poor service. The Gành Hào 2 is located at Front Beach and has great view of the beach. You can enjoy your dinner, watching the sunset on the ocean while listening the wave crashing to the pier. The restaurant has a huge variety of food selection in the menu, but their seafood is the best with live fish, crab, shrimp, clam, oyster... My favorite dishes are steam grouper, tiger shrimp mixed with garlic and butter, soft shelled crab with salt, oyster stuffing with cheese. They also have cool selection of red wine and white wine to complete your dinner. They even have my favorite Malbec imported from Argentina (most the restaurants in Vungtau do not have Malbec). I highly recommend this restaurant for your Vungtau visit.
